memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: When Enosh had lived 90 years, he became the father of Kenan. Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters, and then he died. When Kenan had lived 70 years, he became the father of Mahalalel. Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters, and then he died. - Gen 5:9-14 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Enosh, Kenan - names most of us have never noticed, ordinary people whose stories are told in a single line. They were born, they raised families, they lived, they died. There are no famous deeds recorded, no great achievements listed. And yet God saw fit to write their names into His eternal book.

That should encourage every one of us who feels ordinary. Most of our lives will never make headlines. We work, we raise families, we serve quietly, and one day our time will end. But God notices. He records. Not a single faithful life is forgotten by Him.

This line of Seth was the faithful line - the people who called on the Lord's name and passed their faith from one generation to the next. Their greatness was not in fame but in faithfulness across the years.

The New Testament promises that God "will not forget your work and the love you have shown him" (Heb 6:10). Your quiet, faithful days matter to God. The unseen prayers, the raising of children in the faith, the ordinary obedience - He sees it all, and one day names written in obscurity here will shine in the Book of Life (Rev 20:15).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you believe your ordinary, faithful life matters to God?
- Are you passing faith to the next generation?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You see and remember even ordinary, faithful lives. Help me be faithful in my small corner and pass on my faith to those who follow.
